column1: # Procedural GUI/other apps this repo installs. Read by bin/dotfiles-deps; the installer
# drives each row through ensure_app. The install bodies stay as functions in
# dotfiles-install-lib, found by convention from key: <key>_present / <key>_install_mac /
# <key>_install_linux. key is the function prefix (may differ from label). Tab-separated.
